subject: Exhibit reorg / amendment — handoff to legal for consolidated exhibits
message_1_subject: Consolidate Exhibit mapping + Q1 capacity amendment
message_1_body:
Hi Jordan,

Quick ask from procurement: we need to consolidate Exhibit B (SKU mapping) and Exhibit D (capacity schedule) into a single amendment so our internal SOW team can reallocate 200 committed GPUs from Q2 to Q1. The change will also require a modest price re-tier for the added burst capacity.

Can Redwood provide: 1) a proposed amendment (redline against current Order Form), 2) an updated fee schedule (showing blended vs committed pricing), and 3) an expected signing timeline — NovaOS needs countersign by 2026-12-01 to hit deployment windows.

I attached a short summary (amendment_request_20261113.pdf) showing the SKU lines we want to move. If you prefer, we can push a marked-up Order Form instead. Who should I loop on legal?

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaOS
attachments: amendment_request_20261113.pdf (application/pdf)
message_2_subject: RE: Consolidate Exhibit mapping + Q1 capacity amendment
message_2_body:
Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary.

High level next steps:
- Karthik will prepare two pricing options (blended & committed) for the moved 200 GPUs.
- Legal (we'll loop Marissa) needs an annotated Order Form or a redline of Exhibit B/D to produce a clean amendment.
- Naomi, can you confirm whether finance can accept a blended proration across Q1 vs Q2 for invoicing? If not, we can offer a credit model.

We can turn a first-draft amendment around in 2–3 business days after we get the redline. Tentative timeline: internal review by 11/17, draft to you 11/18, countersign target 12/01 as requested.

If you send the redline, please include the preferred effective date and whether NovaOS wants the additional capacity to be 'sustained reserved' or 'burst eligible'.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
attachments: amendment_request_20261113.pdf (received)
message_3_body:
Jordan / Naomi — I ran two scenarios for the 200-GPU move:

Option A — Blended proration: apply a blended unit price across Q1-Q3 to smooth the impact. Net ARR delta: +8.2% for the term.
Option B — Committed top-up: charge a one-time top-up for Q1 consumption, then revert to original tier pricing. Net ARR delta: +9.7% but preserves per-unit clarity for finance.

I've attached price_proposals_20261116.xlsx with the line-item math and a sample invoice apportionment. Naomi — flag any billing constraints. If we want to offer a small onboarding credit to expedite signing, propose $15k one-time.

Karthik
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
attachments: price_proposals_20261116.xlsx (spreadsheet)

message_5_subject: RE: Exhibit reorg — legal handoff and requested language
message_5_body:
Marissa — looping you in to review NovaOS's annotated redline (attached earlier). Quick summary of commercial asks for legal review: 

- Consolidate Exhibit B/D per NovaOS annotations; effective date should be 2026-11-01 (they require backdating for deployment timelines).
- Add explicit language excluding burst capacity from committed utilization and clarify billing proration approach. Karthik recommended a $15k one-time onboarding credit if we want to expedite.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether backdating the effective date to 11/01 creates any audit or revenue recognition concerns.
2) Suggested amendment language for the burst exclusion clause (short, redline-ready).
3) If we can accept blended proration mechanics or if finance needs a top-up approach.

Target: legal quick review by 11/23 so we can send a clean amendment to NovaOS by 11/24. If legal needs more time, tell me the blocker and we will escalate.

Jordan
